source.section: PDF page 13, Line 13 Pensions (Employer-Funded Pension Plans, items (1) and (2)); Form N-11 line 13; Form N-11 lines 7-12, 19-20 and 23-27 (pages 2-3); PDF page 11 (Line 7), PDF page 20 (Line 23 standard deduction table, Line 25 exemptions), PDF page 9 (Lines 6a, 6b, 'age 65 or over as of January 1, 2026'), PDF page 20 (Line 27 Tax Table), PDF page 50 (2025 Tax Rate Schedules)

worked: Married filing jointly, Hawaii residents, 67 and 64. The older spouse draws a New York State and Local Employees' Retirement System pension 50,000 paid upon retirement (another state's government); the younger spouse has wages 40,000; interest 6,000. Line 13 item (1) names 'a public (i.e., government) retirement system (e.g., ... state or county retirement system)' with no limit to Hawaii's own plans (settlement log row 1), so the New York pension is excluded in full, the same as a Hawaii ERS pension. One age-65 exemption (only the older spouse is 65). Line 7 federal AGI = New York State and Local Employees' Retirement System pension 50,000.00 + wages 40,000.00 + interest 6,000.00 = 96,000.00. Federal taxable income = 96,000.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 1,600.00 age-65 addition = 62,900.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 11 total additions = 0.00; line 12 = 96,000.00 + 0.00 = 96,000.00. Line 13 pensions taxed federally but not taxed by Hawaii (New York State retirement system, item (1)) 50,000.00. Line 19 total subtractions = 50,000.00; line 20 Hawaii AGI = 96,000.00 - 50,000.00 = 46,000.00. Line 23 standard deduction (married filing jointly, PDF page 20 table) 8,800.00; line 24 = 46,000.00 - 8,800.00 = 37,200.00. Line 6e exemptions: 2 regular + 1 age 65 or over = 3; line 25 = 3 x 1,144.00 = 3,432.00. Line 26 taxable income = 37,200.00 - 3,432.00 = 33,768.00. Line 27 tax, Schedule II (PDF page 50) as bands on 33,768.00: 19,200.00 x 1.4% = 268.80; 9,600.00 x 3.2% = 307.20; 4,968.00 x 5.5% = 273.24; sum = 849.24; tax = 849.24 (Form N-11 line 27 uses the Tax Table below 100,000 of taxable income (PDF page 20, Line 27): the table row 33,750 to 33,800 gives 850; this case uses the bands as numbers). No credits modelled (refundable food/excise and renters credits, lines 28-29, not claimed): state income tax = 849.24.
